import { Component, OnInit, OnDestroy, ViewChild, ElementRef, } from '@angular/core'; import { ChatService } from '../../../services/chat.service'; import { ChatMessage, ChatRoom } from '../../../models/chat.model'; @Component({ selector: 'app-admin-chat', templateUrl: './admin-chat.component.html', styleUrls: ['./admin-chat.component.css'], }) export class AdminChatComponent implements OnInit, OnDestroy { @ViewChild('messageContainer') messageContainer!: ElementRef; adminName: string = 'admin'; selectedCustomer: string = ''; messages: ChatMessage[] = []; newMessage: string = ''; customers: ChatRoom[] = []; filteredCustomers: ChatRoom[] = []; isLoading: boolean = false; searchTerm: string = ''; onlineCustomers: string[] = ['John Doe', 'Jane Smith', 'Mike Johnson']; constructor(private chatService: ChatService) {} ngOnInit(): void { this.loadCustomers(); this.connectToChat(); } loadCustomers(): void { this.chatService.getConversations('admin').subscribe({ next: (conversations) => { this.customers = conversations; this.filteredCustomers = conversations; if (this.customers.length > 0 && !this.selectedCustomer) { this.selectedCustomer = this.customers[0].user; this.loadChatHistory(); } }, error: (err) => console.error('Error loading customers:', err), }); } connectToChat(): void { this.chatService.connect('admin').subscribe({ next: (message) => { if (message.sender === this.selectedCustomer) { this.messages.push(message); this.scrollToBottom(); this.playNotification(); } this.loadCustomers(); }, error: (err) => console.error('WebSocket error:', err), }); } loadChatHistory(): void { if (!this.selectedCustomer) return; this.isLoading = true; this.chatService.getChatHistory('admin', this.selectedCustomer).subscribe({ next: (messages) => { this.messages = messages; this.isLoading = false; this.scrollToBottom(); messages.forEach((msg) => { if (!msg.isRead && msg.receiver === 'admin') { this.chatService.markAsRead(msg.id!).subscribe(); } }); }, error: (err) => { console.error('Error loading chat history:', err); this.isLoading = false; }, }); } sendMessage(): void { if (!this.newMessage.trim() || !this.selectedCustomer) return; const message: ChatMessage = { sender: 'admin', receiver: this.selectedCustomer, message: this.newMessage, messageType: 'TEXT', timestamp: new Date(), isRead: false, }; this.chatService.sendMessage(message); this.messages.push(message); this.newMessage = ''; this.scrollToBottom(); } filterCustomers(): void { if (!this.searchTerm) { this.filteredCustomers = this.customers; } else { this.filteredCustomers = this.customers.filter((c) => c.user.toLowerCase().includes(this.searchTerm.toLowerCase()), ); } } selectCustomer(customer: ChatRoom): void { this.selectedCustomer = customer.user; this.loadChatHistory(); } isCustomerOnline(customer: string): boolean { return this.onlineCustomers.includes(customer); } playNotification(): void { const audio = new Audio('/assets/admin-notification.mp3'); audio.play().catch((e) => console.log('Audio play failed')); } scrollToBottom(): void { setTimeout(() => { if (this.messageContainer) { this.messageContainer.nativeElement.scrollTop = this.messageContainer.nativeElement.scrollHeight; } }, 100); } formatTime(date: Date): string { return new Date(date).toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', }); } ngOnDestroy(): void { this.chatService.disconnect(); } }
